user.title: ESPOID Service
user.description: Sets the shared HA announcement address and this node’s firmware source. Do this once while Wi-Fi is available.

data_description.firmware_base_url: Address reachable from ESP, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8123.
data_description.service_base_url: Set once in Service settings. Use the existing HA HTTP or HTTPS origin that the ESP can reach through the firewall.
data_description.search_networks: Comma-separated private networks, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24. Used only when you start a search.
data_description.z2m_prefixes: Optional, comma-separated base topics. Device command topics are derived automatically.
